style: Ultra-photorealistic cinematic low-key textile macro: dark espresso/charcoal atmosphere, warm narrow key beams, volumetric haze, real cotton fiber texture, brushed industrial metal, film grain. One continuous dolly move through six beats: FIBER -> THREAD -> LOOM -> WEAVING -> FABRIC -> BRAND REVEAL. Final frame = dark woven textile + AERO COTTON wordmark + thin brass line + tagline, designed to hand off seamlessly into the website's cocoa fabric hero.
font: Fraunces (self-hosted woff2 from the site, serif fallback Georgia)

customize.note: No catalog block reused: the six-beat procedural fabric journey has no shipped equivalent. Hand-authored per the logo-reveal module's hand-author path; the brand finale follows logo-outro's spirit (lockup + underline sweep + tagline, no URL pill).

content.logo: typographic wordmark (site typeface Fraunces, tracked uppercase ivory)

scenes.motion: extreme macro: single SVG cotton fiber (turbulence-displaced stroke + seeded fuzz), narrow warm beam, camera travels alongside; ghost fibers blurred for shallow DoF
fiber becomes seven spun threads entering under tension (staggered slide, micro-jitter), beam widens, guides enter frame edges
camera pulls back: warp sheet, brushed-metal rollers (rolling stripe illusion), shuttle bar beating, eyelet guides, warm industrial pools
macro weave: hero weft crosses warp with alternating over-segments, formed cloth grows from below, light sweep travels the surface
full-bleed flowing cloth: parallax fold layers, turbulence weave texture, warm sweep, cloth rises and fills the frame
cloth darkens to woven cocoa surface; wordmark letters blur-reveal in stagger; brass line sweeps; tagline rises; hold
